notes: Final run, after changing operation-level SQLite connections to close explicitly and adding mixed read/write cells.
Warm filesystem cache. No long-lived file index or task cache; each query enumerates all 1000 Markdown files and parses their YAML headers.
Markdown parser variants: PyYAML CSafeLoader and SafeLoader. Both use CSafeDumper for writes; comments and YAML formatting are not round-tripped.
Writes use flock, temporary sibling file, file fsync, os.replace, directory fsync. SQLite uses WAL, synchronous=FULL, BEGIN IMMEDIATE for mutation.
No F_FULLFSYNC or power-failure testing; no claim of matched crash-durability guarantees. File reads without the admission lock are not multi-file snapshots.
Counts describe the initial fixture. Claims mutate ready tasks between cells; claims are reset before each claim cell. All three backends follow the same sequence.
Eight calls per cell at 1 or 4 clients, 32 at 16; pure-Python parser omitted at 16 clients. Capacity probe: 16 calls per backend. Sample p95 is nearest rank.
Native task APIs, Git operations, hot-source preparation, production schema validation, permission checks, and observability are not included.
